feed.title: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Expands Workforcelinc Intermodal Technician Training Program to Baltimore in Partnership with Cmc
feed.summary: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation's WorkforceLinc division is expanding its intermodal technician training program to the Port of Baltimore, partnering with CMC. This expansion builds on existing collaborations in Savannah, GA; Charleston, SC; and Wilmington, NC, aiming to deliver consistent, hands-on training directly within port operating environments. Since its launch in 2024, the program has trained over 90 CMC technicians, and the Baltimore expansion is expected to further enhance workforce development in key logistics hubs.

feed.title: T-Mobile’s $85 Billion Debt Load Won’t Feel the Fed’s Rate Hike the Way Wall Street Thinks
feed.summary: T-Mobile's substantial debt load is largely insulated from recent Federal Reserve rate hikes because most of its $86.9 billion debt consists of fixed-rate notes, not floating-rate debt. Only about $1 billion of its debt is tied to floating rates, making the common Wall Street calculation of a $212 million increase in annual interest largely misleading. The company's strong free cash flow, projected at $18.4 to $18.8 billion for 2026, further mitigates the impact of any incremental interest costs, positioning T-Mobile more favorably than some analysts suggest.

feed.title: WK Kellogg supports regen ag program in UK
feed.summary: WK Kellogg Co has partnered with Soil Capital to launch a large-scale wheat sourcing program in the UK, aiming to help 25 British farmers adopt regenerative agricultural practices across nearly 4,000 hectares. This five-year initiative provides guidance and financial incentives, along with tools for tracking soil health and farm resilience improvements. The program supports 100% of the locally sourced wheat for Kellogg's British cereals, including Special K, and aims to strengthen the UK wheat supply chain while reducing agricultural supply chain emissions.

feed.title: Ford’s Yield Is One of the Loudest in the Market. Is the Payout Actually Safe?

feed.title: This Stock Pays a Dividend Every Month. Inside a Roth IRA, the IRS Doesn’t Tax Any of It
feed.summary: Realty Income (NYSE: O) offers a monthly dividend, but its tax treatment as ordinary income makes account placement crucial. Holding O shares in a Roth IRA can shelter investors from significant annual taxes, particularly for those in higher tax brackets, unlike a taxable brokerage account where distributions are taxed as ordinary income. The article emphasizes that this strategy can save investors thousands of dollars over time, recommending Roth IRAs for ordinary-income payers like REITs.

feed.title: Dow and Amcor launch strategic collaboration to accelerate adoption of low-carbon packaging solutions
feed.summary: Dow and Amcor have formed a strategic collaboration to help brands and retailers adopt low-carbon packaging solutions and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, particularly Scope 3 emissions. This partnership combines Dow's expertise in low-carbon polyethylene and carbon footprint analysis with Amcor's packaging innovation and manufacturing capabilities. They will identify viable applications, engage partners, and use the Carbon Footprint Ledger methodology to provide transparent carbon footprint information, making it easier for customers to integrate sustainable packaging.

feed.title: Merck Launches Your Hive of Whole Health to Support Whole Person Care for People Living With HIV
feed.summary: Merck has launched "Your Hive of Whole Health," a multi-year educational program designed to help people living with HIV build support networks for their physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being. Unveiled at the 2026 U.S. Conference on HIV/AIDS (USCHA), the initiative emphasizes whole-person care beyond viral suppression, with actress and advocate Debbie Allen joining the launch. The program provides tools and resources for individuals to create personalized "Hives" of care, involving healthcare providers, community advocates, family, and peers.

feed.title: Joby Completes First-Ever Fully Autonomous Flight Across the United States
feed.summary: Joby Aviation announced the completion of the first-ever fully autonomous flight across the United States by an aircraft equipped with its autonomy technology. This milestone demonstrates the real-world operational maturity, safety, and dual-use utility of Joby’s autonomy technology for commercial freight, emergency response, and defense logistics.
